content: The fund is domiciled in Luxembourg as an open-ended sub-fund with segregated assets under the umbrella vehicle Aurora Strategies SICAV (S02). It is structured as an alternative long/short equity fund intended for professional investors, rather than being presented as a UCITS, and has an indefinite duration in the scenario (S02). The vehicle represents a fictional contractual structure with no actual registrations, authorisations, passports, or regulatory classifications attributed to it (S02).
